recommendations.action: Fix self-canonicalization: /catering and /shabbat both set their canonical tag to the homepage (https://thehungryroostertx.com) rather than to themselves. Give every page a self-referencing canonical.
recommendations.reason: Verified on the subpages fetched this run. summary: The Hungry Rooster still holds page-one positions only for its two catering terms (now ~#5 for 'kosher catering Dallas' and ~#6 for 'Jewish catering Dallas'), and both appear to have slipped a few spots this week while the Meat Point group expanded with a new kosher sushi spot, Shi-Ya. We remain invisible for food, restaurant, delivery, and Shabbat queries — largely due to unchanged, fixable on-site issues: /shabbat still renders only 'Loading...' to crawlers and subpages canonicalize to the homepage with duplicate titles. Top priorities this week are pre-rendering /shabbat, giving each page its own canonical and unique title/meta to defend the slipping catering rankings, and claiming the Google Business Profile plus directory listings.
